_comment: Tier-2 dual-driver parity fixture for the in-process sim SUCCESS path (ADR-005 §4.2). The SELFDESTRUCT-gift fixture: the executor stub CALLs a gift contract; the gift SELFDESTRUCTs to the executor (CALLER), sending 1 ETH → gross_profit = 1 ETH → non-None SimResult. Multicall3 bytecode deployed so getEthBalance returns real ETH balances. Driven through BOTH the Rust consumer (simulate_in_process_with_db directly) + the Python consumer (simulate_in_process_success_probe PyO3 binding). The expected values are RECORDED constants (the revm EVM run is the truth — no closed-form derivation of gas_used/priority_fee exists). A deliberately-wrong edit fails BOTH halves. Oracle: recorded constant (weaker than the V2 calc parity's closed form).

fixture.comment: SELFDESTRUCT gift success-path over CacheDB<EmptyDB>. Executor stub = PUSH1 0x00 ×5 PUSH20 <gift> GAS CALL POP STOP. Gift = CALLER SELFDESTRUCT (sends 1 ETH to executor). Multicall3 = PUSH1 0x04 CALLDATALOAD BALANCE PUSH1 0x00 MSTORE PUSH1 0x20 PUSH1 0x00 RETURN (getEthBalance). block_priority_fees=None, base_fee_next=1G, current_block=solve_block=100 (age=0, no decay).
